title: 第14章 姐等不了了，今天必须得到你~~
slug: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
周香兰不愧是结过婚的女人，就是奔放，这话说的太有画面感了，李大壮瞬间“火气更深”，一个翻身，跟周香兰调转了方向。

    “香兰姐，你真香……”

    其实，香的何止是周香兰本人，她住的这间屋子都香喷喷的，那枕头边的黑色半镂空文胸，紫色轻纱睡裙，和睡裙下面，若隐若现的黑色小裤……

    就连床上的酒红色床单被套，都散发着阵阵勾人的女人香！

    “傻小子，姐哪里香呀？”周香兰却还嫌不够似的，曲起一条白花花的长腿，贴在李大壮侧腰，水眸如波般看着他，娇吟勾引间，碎花裙的衣领被扯开，露出半片雪白……

    “哪儿都香，尤其是这儿……”

    李大壮再也忍不住，扑向那片雪白柔软……

    天雷马上就要勾动地火，旱地马上就要迎来她渴望的雨水！

    可就在这么关键的时候，李大壮那个破手机的铃声，却忽然响了起来！

    “大壮~别~别接了，姐等不了了……”

    开玩笑，周香兰好不容易盼来了这一刻，咋可能轻易放过李大壮，今天不缠他个腿软腰晃，是不可能让他下这张床！

    可李大壮心中却有点不好的预感，连忙捂住周香兰的嘴，自己一听，果然隐约听见自家院子里传来争吵声。

    “不行，香兰姐我得先回家，下次再说！”李大壮直接从床上跳下来，李香兰想拦，可她浑身软绵绵的，哪里抓得住李大壮？

    “这混小子，弄的老娘不上不下的，他却跑了，真是气死人了！”周香兰身子还软着，露在外面的半片雪白，没了压迫感，别提有多空虚了。

    实在没办法，她只能盖上夏凉被，幻想着李大壮还没走…………

    而此时的李大壮正一边飞奔，一边掏手机。

    果然是秋霜姐打来的。

    “喂姐……”

    “大壮快回来！村长和王耀根，还有好多人，来咱家闹事儿了，让咱爸妈赔他们十万块医药费，不然就拿咱家的宅基地抵！”

    手机那头传来李秋霜带着哭腔的声音。

    随后电话那头又传来王耀根猥琐的声音：“不光要用宅基地抵，你也得给我当媳妇儿！！”
content_en:

"Hmm~~~"

A faint humming floated out from the creek behind Xinghua Village, carrying a sense of indescribable loneliness and restlessness.

The pretty widow Liu Meiyu's naked snow-white body, her eyes slightly closed, was soaking in the cool river water. Her long black hair was wet and clinging to her white and smooth shoulders. The water droplets slid down her graceful neck, rolled into the two plump and round breasts on her chest, and then submerged into the clear river water.

Liu Meiyu has been a widow for two years, and her life has been difficult. The weather has been hot recently, and she has become very anxious. She has to wait for a long time before she can fall asleep every night.

I couldn't bear it any more today, so I took advantage of noon, when the villagers were taking a nap at home, to secretly take a dip in the creek to see if it could dispel the heat and intolerance in my heart.

"Wow!"

Suddenly, a reckless sound of water came from downstream.

Liu Meiyu opened her eyes suddenly and looked downstream cautiously. She saw a tall and strong figure emerging from the reeds. It was the fool Li Dazhuang.

Li Dazhuang was originally the only college student in the village. He was tall and handsome, and he was the fantasy object of many young girls and young wives.

But when he was in college, he offended the powerful people in the city and was beaten into a fool and thrown back to the village!

At this time, Li Dazhuang hadn't noticed Liu Meiyu yet. He put his hands in the water and muttered: "Fish...big fish...bring it back to my sister..."

Liu Meiyu was panicking at first, but looking at Li Dazhuang's stupid look, her thoughts changed: Although Dazhuang was stupid, he still looked so attractive and had a strong body. If she could have a fight with him, wouldn't it be so difficult?

Just thinking about it, Liu Meiyu felt hot all over and accidentally made some water noises.

"Who?" Li Dazhuang suddenly stopped and looked straight into the shadow of the reeds.

When their eyes met, Liu Meiyu's heart skipped a beat and she quickly squatted into the water, her pretty face flushed red.

"Mei, sister-in-law Meiyu..." Li Dazhuang stammered, his eyes fixed on her exposed snow-white shoulders, grinning innocently, "Beautiful...even more beautiful than the wild flowers at the head of the village..."

Liu Meiyu's heart trembled at the sight of him, and the unspeakable emptiness and restlessness became even more intense!

Liu Meiyu's heart skipped a beat, and she stood up directly, revealing her snow-white upper body. Her watery eyes were shy, as if they could draw threads, and they stuck directly to Li Dazhuang's body.

"Dazhuang, are you ashamed to peek at your sister-in-law taking a shower?"

Li Dazhuang scratched his head and stood stupidly, staring at the thing that looked like a steamed bun, his Adam's apple rolled unconsciously: "Sister-in-law is good-looking, Dazhuang didn't peek, it was sister-in-law who came out on her own."

Liu Meiyu chuckled, and took a few steps to stand in front of Li Dazhuang. The woman's fragrance mixed with hot air entered his nose, and Sha Dazhuang couldn't help but smell it again and again.
